matches.tactical_summary: Belgium delivered a commanding attacking performance, utilizing fluid movement and individual brilliance to dismantle New Zealand's defense and secure a comfortable win. New Zealand struggled to contain the Belgian onslaught but managed to grab a consolation goal from a set-piece late in the game.

narrative: Belgium secured a resounding 5-1 victory over New Zealand in their final Group G match, ensuring their progression to the knockout stages. The dominant performance saw multiple goal scorers for Belgium, while New Zealand exited the tournament despite a late consolation goal.
